entries.text_en:
British Museum 5485 f. 39, c. 1600, In Cn, below, p. 612, from H.

6668, 16th century, Ps Cn for, below, p. 620, from Ho.

16278, 16th century, Ine Af AGu As Cnut, in Latin, from K2.

21088, Huntingdon5, copied in 1569 from the Lb class; f. 132 Tripartita, i.e. ECf retr, below, p. 627, and the Geneal. Normannica.

transcription.doubts: 'Tripartita' here is in roman, not bold. 'xliii' in n. 5 is in small capitals.
